authenticity_review: High photorealism overall: excellent lighting, material rendering (leather, brass), and composition. However, two artifacts reduce authenticity: (1) Structural collapse on leftmost trumpet’s valve tubing — tubes appear fused/melted, violating physical boundary integrity (severity 2); (2) Suitcase interior lining lacks fabric weave detail, appearing unnaturally smooth/plastic (severity 1). These prevent a perfect authenticity score despite strong perceptual quality.

Unnaturally uniform, plastic-like texture on suitcase interior lining (severity 1)
